title: Info
hub_about_desc: Data sources, how Rt is calculated, and who made PICO
tips_note: A summary of public sources. It does not replace a doctor's advice.
not_reviewed: Not yet reviewed by a health professional
about_name: PICO Sulteng is the COVID-19 Information Centre of Central Sulawesi (Pusat Informasi COVID-19 Sulawesi Tengah).
about_archive: This app keeps COVID-19 data from $start to $end. Data updates stopped on $end. This app is an archive.
source_1: A program (scraper) reads cumulative figures from a third-party site. Daily values are computed as the difference of two consecutive days. The data is stored in a database, and an open API serves it to this app.
source_2: Coverage: Indonesia and 34 provinces from $start to $end, and 13 regencies and cities in Central Sulawesi. Vaccination, test, hospital and contact data come from the old PICO database.
source_3: The third-party site is m.andrafarm.com (Andra Farm), its pages listing cases by province and by city. It states that its figures come from kemkes.go.id (pusatkrisis.kemkes.go.id), covid19.go.id and BNPB. That is the site's own statement, not a check made by PICO. The pages were read on 24 October 2026.
source_4: Because the data is taken automatically from another source, PICO does not guarantee its accuracy. Where it differs from the official source, the official source is right.
m_daily_1: A daily value is the difference between the cumulative total of that day and the day before. It can be 0 on days with no report, and it can include late reports from earlier days.
m_daily_2: So a single day does not mean much. Look at the average of several days or a longer trend.
m_daily_3: The daily number of patients under treatment can be negative because it is the difference of two cumulative values.
m_rt_1: Rt is an estimate of the average number of people one infected person infects at a given time. Rt is estimated with EpiEstim (Cori et al., 2013) in R, from daily new cases.
m_rt_2: Serial interval (the time between the symptoms of one case and the case it infected): parametric, mean $mean days, standard deviation $sd days.
m_rt_3: Window: $window days. Each value is labelled with the end date of its window.
m_rt_4: Rt is not computed (empty) for a window with fewer than $min new cases. That is why Rt is missing early in the pandemic, in quiet periods, and after mid-2023.
m_rt_5: The app shows the estimate and its $percent% credible interval. An Rt above 1 means spread is growing, below 1 means it is shrinking. The interval matters more than the single number.
m_gap_1: ODP and PDP stop after $odp for Central Sulawesi. The source no longer reported them, so the app shows "not available", not 0.
m_gap_2: The gender and age data and the test totals are snapshots without a date. They are shown as the latest recorded data.
m_gap_5: Regency and city data has no figure for patients under treatment.
m_gap_6: Images from the old server are gone.
m_health: The health tip articles and the home isolation guide are put together from public sources (WHO and the Ministry of Health). No medical professional has reviewed them, and they do not replace a doctor's advice.
license_data: PICO did not create the original data. m.andrafarm.com allows its information to be copied and pasted as long as the main source is credited, and it names no licence. PICO grants no licence for this data. If you use it, please credit PICO Sulteng, m.andrafarm.com and the original source (the Ministry of Health).
license_map: Map data: the old boundary files of the PICO project, in the repository since 23 May 2020. Their origin and licence are not recorded.
license_fonts: Type: Archivo and Source Sans 3 (OFL licence).
credit_brand: The PICO logo is the owner's legacy logo, unchanged. The illustrations and icons were drawn for this app.
culture_1: Kaili motifs are communal heritage of the Kaili people. They do not belong to PICO. Every kabupaten pattern is an interpretation drawn from written descriptions. None is an authentic reproduction, and no photograph of real cloth was used.
culture_2: Sourced motifs (interpretations): Donggala, that is Buya Subi (diamond field and flowering vine) and the Buya Bomba Kota check; Kota Palu, that is a simple vine-and-flower bomba from Batik Bomba; Poso, that is bark-cloth tumpal and diamond in natural brown and cream.
culture_3: Stylised, not traditional: Banggai, Morowali, Parigi Moutong, Sigi, Tolitoli, Morowali Utara, Tojo Una-Una, Buol, Banggai Kepulauan and Banggai Laut use original plain-weave structures.
culture_4: Not used: Taiganja and Sambulugana, because they are sacred Kaili adat objects; white fuya ritual cloth cues; Buya Sabe in any funeral context; the registered batik of Parigi Moutong (Saga), Buol and Morowali (Ikzara, Tobungku).
culture_review: These motifs have not been reviewed by Dinas Kebudayaan Sulawesi Tengah or Dekranasda. The artwork is drawn from written descriptions, not from photographs of real cloth.
